sources.excerpt: by CostaLab Website Link Model Number or Name: Natural Drive MkII Distortion Overdrive Circuit Type: Analog Electrical Components: Germanium Transistor/Diode Original Price: $259 Excellent Used Price: $199 Alternate Version(s) Natrual Drive (2011) The Costalab Natural Drive MkII is a pedal built on two fundamental cornerstones: dynamics and expressiveness. Its circuit is based on the most classic distortion network with symmetrical clipping. The presence of germanium diodes gives a very round vintage tone rich in harmonics. The timbre of the guitar is not modified in any way, even with the sustain regulated to the maximum, using the volume control of the instrument or simply playing with very light dynamics, it is possible to return to the clean sound, vice versa, using it with an energetic playing, the Natural Drive MKII responds by producing a rich and incisive distorted sound. The resulting sensation is the same as that obtained by playing with the old single-channel tube amps, pulled at maximum volume. Once you reach the right dynamic feeling, your expressiveness will be highlighted like never before. The ultimate in dynamics, expressiveness and headroom CostaLab Natural drive MKII Review by Edoardo Scordo CostaLab Natural Drive mkII Email Sugaree Licks any additional Promotional Videos
